name: RS6 Avant
description: The Audi RS6 Avant (2002–present) is the definitive performance estate and one of the most influential fast cars in history. The C5's twin-turbocharged 4.2-litre V8 (450 hp), the C7's 4.0-litre V8 (560 hp), and the C8's 4.0-litre V8 hybrid (600 hp) form a lineage of barely restrained family cars that can outrun supercars. The RS6 Avant defined the genre.
